orbit_rule: 2-homogeneous action of AGL+(1, 271) = {x -> s*x + b mod 271 : s in QR_271} on F_271. Every triple {a,b,c} (a < b < c) maps to {0, 1, z} with z = (c-a)*(b-a)^(-1) mod p if (b-a) in QR_271 else (c-b)*(a-b)^(-1) mod p; orbits are ordered by increasing smallest z in {2..270} (equivalently, lexicographically smallest triple {0, 1, z_min}).
